name: Fukidamari no Kanojo
source:
**Wanting to save her, wanting to be saved by her.**  
On a summer night, in a corner of the city,  
the protagonist reunites with a childhood friend from whom he had been separated.

Time that will not return. Feelings that have never changed.  
Two hands overlapping, even as they sadly miss each other.  
Even their desperate prayers vanish into the darkness of the night.
